name: role
description: A role (here nfdi:NFDI_0000114, contact point role) is a first-class individual that is role-of an agent via obo:RO_0000081, rather than an attribute of the agent. Its descriptive values, such as an email address, hang off it as value nodes reached by obo:IAO_0000235.
competency_questions: Which role does a given person or organisation bear, and in what context?; Which contact point is responsible for a given resource?
